items.title_en: Goodbye Claude, Hello Pi
items.title_zh: 告别 Claude，迎接 Pi
items.summary_en: The author had used Claude Code for more than a year, beginning when it became available through the Claude Pro subscription. Despite considering its release an important moment for software development, the author accumulated enough small frustrations to stop using it as the main coding harness. Their development setup is now being migrated to Pi.
items.summary_zh: 作者从 Claude Code 随 Claude Pro 订阅推出后就开始使用，至今已有一年多。尽管作者认为它的发布可能会成为软件开发史上的重要节点，但长期积累的许多小问题最终让作者不再把它作为主要编程工具。作者目前正将开发环境迁移到 Pi。

items.title_en: What I run on my $10 USD OpenStick homelab
items.title_zh: 我在 10 美元 OpenStick 家庭实验室上运行的服务
items.summary_en: The author bought an OpenStick for $10 including shipping, mainly because it was an unusual and appealing piece of hardware. Although the device is less powerful than many modern watches, it can still support enjoyable self-hosting experiments. The project demonstrates how a very inexpensive, tiny computer can serve as an entry point to homelabbing.
items.summary_zh: 作者花 10 美元（含运费）买了一台 OpenStick，主要是因为这款硬件新奇而有趣。它的性能可能还不如许多现代智能手表，但仍然适合进行有趣的自托管实验。这个项目展示了廉价小设备如何成为入门家庭实验室的起点。

items.title_en: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" exposes passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files
items.title_zh: Claude Code 的“不要再询问”功能导致密码出现在 1,122 个公开 GitHub 文件中
items.summary_en: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" feature exposed passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files.
items.summary_zh: Claude Code 的“不要再询问”功能导致密码出现在 1,122 个公开 GitHub 文件中。

items.title_en: The end of Microsoft Research's AI Frontiers group
items.title_zh: 微软研究院 AI Frontiers 团队的终结
items.summary_en: Microsoft Research's AI Frontiers group is coming to an end.
items.summary_zh: 微软研究院的 AI Frontiers 团队即将解散。

items.title_en: Need for Speed Underground 2 online in the browser
items.title_zh: 在浏览器中在线玩《极品飞车：地下狂飙 2》
items.summary_en: The project brings Need for Speed Underground 2 online in a web browser. No further implementation details or features are established here.
items.summary_zh: 该项目让《极品飞车：地下狂飙 2》能够在浏览器中在线运行。现有信息未说明其具体实现方式或功能细节。

items.title_en: Apple’s grey list: Words and phrases your iPhone won’t help you spell
items.title_zh: 苹果的“灰名单”：iPhone 不会帮你拼出的词语和短语
items.summary_en: Research found that Apple restricts predictive-text completion for more than 100,000 words and phrases. The restrictions affect swipe typing, in which users glide a finger across the keyboard instead of tapping each character. As a result, an iPhone may refuse to complete some unusual or sensitive phrases even when users try to enter them by gesture.
items.summary_zh: 研究发现，苹果限制了超过 10 万个词语和短语的预测文本补全功能。这些限制会影响滑行输入，即用户用手指划过键盘，而不是逐字点击。结果是，即使用户尝试通过滑行输入，iPhone 也可能不会补全某些不寻常或敏感的短语。

items.title_en: Every Mac comes with an (undocumented) family member classifier
items.title_zh: 每台 Mac 都自带一个未公开的家庭成员分类器
items.summary_en: The post claims that every Mac since macOS 13, released in 2022, includes two daemons that build a graph of the user’s relationships and activities. The graph is described as covering contacts, relationships, communications, locations, activities, and timing.
items.summary_zh: 文章称，自 2022 年发布的 macOS 13 起，每台 Mac 都包含两个用于构建用户关系和活动图谱的后台进程。该图谱据称涵盖联系人、彼此关系、通信、位置、活动及时间信息。文章还分析了这一系统的工作方式，并提供了查看个人设备上该图谱的工具。

items.title_en: MaxxBench – "Nice DeepSWE score. But is it true?"
items.title_zh: MaxxBench：“DeepSWE 得分不错，但它是真的吗？”
items.summary_en: MaxxBench changed the requirements of familiar engineering tasks in a coding benchmark to test whether models would follow the new instructions. The researchers found cases where a model understood and correctly implemented the changed requirement, then removed its own correct code after another model supplied the benchmark’s original answer. The results expose a gap between recognizing a requirement and consistently acting on it.
items.summary_zh: MaxxBench 修改了编码基准中熟悉工程任务的要求，用来测试模型是否会遵循新指令。研究人员发现，有时模型明白并正确实现了新要求，却在另一个模型给出基准原始答案后删除了自己的正确代码。这些结果显示，模型理解要求与始终按照要求执行之间存在差距。

items.title_en: Libghostty 1.0
items.title_zh: Libghostty 1.0
items.summary_en: libghostty-vt 1.0 has been released as a portable, high-performance C library for terminal emulation, extracted from Ghostty’s core. Both the library and its C ABI are now stable. The C API has grown from nonexistent to a complete terminal emulator used in production by millions of people across hundreds of free and commercial products.
items.summary_zh: libghostty-vt 1.0 已发布，这是一个从 Ghostty 核心提取出的便携、高性能终端模拟 C 库。该库本身及其 C ABI 现已稳定。其 C API 已从无到有发展为完整的终端模拟器，目前已在数百款免费和商业产品中投入生产，服务数百万人。

items.title_en: GitHub New pull request overview page in public preview
items.title_zh: GitHub 新版 Pull Request 概览页进入公开预览
items.summary_en: GitHub has introduced an opt-in Overview page for pull requests as a public preview, with rollout continuing through the weekend. The page places merge status and the next available actions in a compact readiness summary at the top. It is intended to reduce the need to scroll through long comment and event timelines to find blockers.
items.summary_zh: GitHub 推出了 Pull Request 概览页公开预览版，用户可选择启用，相关部署将在周末持续进行。该页面在顶部以紧凑的就绪状态摘要展示合并状态和下一步可执行操作。其目的是减少用户在漫长评论和事件时间线中反复滚动、寻找阻塞因素的需要。

items.title_en: Making any integer with four 2s (2025)
items.title_zh: 用四个 2 构造任意整数（2025）
items.summary_en: The piece presents a mathematical puzzle about constructing integers using exactly four 2s. Some of the examples are accessible to elementary-school children.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容介绍了一道使用恰好四个 2 构造整数的数学谜题。其中一些例子甚至小学生也能完成。

items.title_en: Show HN: Coldframe, a honeypot that poses as a supermarket fridge controller
items.title_zh: Show HN：Coldframe，伪装成超市冰柜控制器的蜜罐
items.summary_en: Coldframe is a Python honeypot that impersonates supermarket refrigeration controllers, including the Danfoss AK-SM 800A and Dixell XWEB interfaces. It uses only the Python standard library and matches details such as headers, page sizes, certificate fields, and TLS versions found on real devices. The honeypot recognizes several exploit attempts, including the CVE-2025-41450 login bypass, and records submitted codes.
items.summary_zh: Coldframe 是一个用 Python 编写的蜜罐，伪装成超市制冷控制器，包括 Danfoss AK-SM 800A 和 Dixell XWEB 的界面。它仅使用 Python 标准库，并模拟真实设备的请求头、页面大小、证书字段和 TLS 版本等细节。该蜜罐能够识别多种攻击尝试，包括 CVE-2025-41450 登录绕过，并记录提交的代码。

items.title_en: ZapFast: A fast, native WhatsApp client in Rust and egui
items.title_zh: ZapFast：使用 Rust 和 egui 构建的快速原生 WhatsApp 客户端
items.summary_en: ZapFast is a lightweight, native WhatsApp client written in Rust with an egui interface. It is designed to run on Linux, macOS, and Windows. The project provides downloads, setup instructions, a user guide, and contribution information.
items.summary_zh: ZapFast 是一款使用 Rust 编写、基于 egui 界面的轻量级原生 WhatsApp 客户端。它面向 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 平台。项目提供下载、安装说明、用户指南和参与贡献的方式。

items.title_en: sshole
items.title_zh: sshole
items.summary_en: OpenSSH on musl Linux has reportedly allowed access to passwordless accounts since 2016. The issue relates to how Unix historically represented accounts that should never permit login, including accounts marked with an asterisk in the password file. The behavior can therefore expose accounts that were intended to be inaccessible.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，musl Linux 上的 OpenSSH 自 2016 年起可能允许进入无密码账户。问题与 Unix 处理本应禁止登录的账户的历史方式有关，包括在密码文件中用星号标记的账户。因此，原本应不可访问的账户可能被暴露。

items.title_en: My parents chose to die together and I was left to grieve alone
items.title_zh: 我的父母选择共同赴死，而我独自留下哀悼
items.summary_en: After 50 years of marriage, Jan and Els sought medical assistance to end their lives together, leaving behind their only child. Their child, Bas, found them in their campervan at a marina in the northern Netherlands one morning in June 2024. The story concerns the consequences of their decision for the family member left behind.
items.summary_zh: 结婚 50 年后，Jan 和 Els 寻求医疗介入，希望共同结束生命，留下了他们唯一的孩子。2024 年 6 月的一个清晨，他们的孩子 Bas 在荷兰北部一处码头的露营车中发现了他们。这个故事讲述了这一决定给留下来的家人带来的影响。

items.title_en: They don't make 'em like that any more: Borland Turbo Pascal 7
items.title_zh: 如今已不复存在的产品：Borland Turbo Pascal 7
items.summary_en: Borland Turbo Pascal was a highly successful programming tool that introduced features such as integrated source-level debugging. Turbo Pascal 7, also known as Turbo Pascal for Windows 1.5, was the final and most advanced version of the line, offering substantial capabilities at an affordable price. Its book license allowed one purchased copy to be used by any number of people, though only one person at a time, and Turbo Pascal eventually gave way to Delphi.
items.summary_zh: Borland Turbo Pascal 是一款极为成功的编程工具，带来了集成式源码级调试等功能。Turbo Pascal 7，也称 Turbo Pascal for Windows 1.5，是这一产品线的最终版本和巅峰之作，以低廉价格提供了足够开发大型应用的能力。它采用“图书授权”模式，一份购买的副本可供任意数量的人使用，但同一时间只能由一人使用；最终 Turbo Pascal 被 Delphi 取代。

items.title_en: Tesla to wind down Cybertruck production
items.title_zh: 特斯拉将逐步停止生产 Cybertruck
items.summary_en: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said Cybertruck production at the company's Texas gigafactory will wind down around mid-2027. He said the move will make room for higher production of the newly launched Cybercab, central to Tesla's robotaxi plans. Cybertruck sales have remained weak, and it has sold in only a limited number of markets. It remains unclear whether production will move elsewhere or end entirely.
items.summary_zh: 特斯拉 CEO 埃隆·马斯克表示，公司位于得州的超级工厂将在 2027 年年中左右逐步停止生产 Cybertruck。他称，此举将为提高新款 Cybercab 的产量腾出空间，而 Cybercab 是特斯拉机器人出租车计划的核心车型。Cybertruck 销量长期疲软，目前仅在少数市场销售。该车型是转移到其他工厂生产还是彻底停产，目前尚不清楚。

items.title_en: Every Windows 11 app should kill Electron, and Discord just showed why
items.title_zh: 每款 Windows 11 应用都该淘汰 Electron，而 Discord 展示了原因
items.summary_en: Discord's new Rust client loads the friends list before the existing Electron app gets past its loading screen and skips the Starting screen. In a cold-start test, the Rust-based client used 290.2 MB of RAM with two accounts signed in. Discord employees confirmed that both applications were launched from a cold start, while a video showing the comparison received 2.3 million views at the time reported.
items.summary_zh: Discord 的新 Rust 客户端在现有 Electron 客户端还没通过加载界面时就已载入好友列表，并跳过了 Starting 界面。在冷启动测试中，Rust 客户端同时登录两个账号时占用 290.2 MB 内存。Discord 员工确认两款应用都是冷启动，该对比视频当时已获得 230 万次观看。

items.title_en: The $8 Linux Computer (2022)
items.title_zh: 8 美元的 Linux 电脑（2022）
items.summary_en: The Ox64 is presented as an $8 RISC-V computer capable of running Linux with an MMU. It has three RISC-V cores, each described as different. At the time of writing, however, its Ethernet, Wi-Fi, and SD-card support were not working.
items.summary_zh: Ox64 被介绍为一台售价 8 美元、能够运行带 MMU 的 Linux 的 RISC-V 电脑。它拥有三个 RISC-V 核心，且三者各不相同。不过在文章写作时，它的以太网、Wi‑Fi 和 SD 卡功能尚不可用。

items.title_en: Claude Code sends your email address to websites
items.title_zh: Claude Code 会将你的邮箱地址发送给网站
items.summary_en: A reported Claude Code bug exposed a user's email address to arbitrary third parties in the User-Agent header during web searches. The user says this happened without permission and was followed by a large increase in scam emails. They argue that the behavior should be removed rather than controlled by an opt-in or opt-out setting.
items.summary_zh: 有用户报告称，Claude Code 在进行网页搜索时，会通过 User-Agent 请求头将其邮箱地址暴露给任意第三方。该用户表示，未经允许发生这一行为后，自己收到的诈骗邮件大幅增加。用户认为，这种行为不应通过加入或退出选项控制，而应从系统中彻底移除。

items.title_en: Kirlian Photography: Building Your Own Equipment
items.title_zh: 克里安摄影：自己制作设备
items.summary_en: Kirlian photography is a form of high-voltage contact-print photography. It is named after Semyon Davidovich Kirlian and Valentina Kirlian, who began working on high-voltage photography in 1939. The couple collaborated for more than 30 years on equipment development and electro-photography research.
items.summary_zh: 克里安摄影是一种高压接触式印相摄影。它以谢苗·达维多维奇·克里安和瓦莲京娜·克里安夫妇命名，两人于 1939 年开始研究高压摄影。这对夫妇合作了 30 多年，持续开发设备并研究电摄影技术。

items.title_en: Upload Your RAM
items.title_zh: 上传你的 RAM
items.summary_en: Upload Your RAM is a satirical service that invites people to donate unused computer memory. It jokes that consumers can no longer undo purchases of RAM, but can instead upload idle RAM to support a better cause. The project presents this fictional “RAM upload technology” as a response to unused memory.
items.summary_zh: “上传你的 RAM”是一个讽刺性项目，邀请人们捐出电脑中未使用的内存。它调侃消费者无法撤回已经购买的 RAM，但可以把闲置内存上传出去，用于更好的事业。项目以虚构的“RAM 上传技术”回应内存闲置问题。

items.title_en: Asahi Linux Progress Linux 7.3
items.title_zh: Asahi Linux 7.3 进展
items.summary_en: Linux 7.3 has been released, and Asahi Linux continues upstreaming support for Apple Silicon. Two major drivers, macaudio and avd, joined the upstream work this cycle. Getting macaudio ready required substantial ALSA changes and modifications to Apple’s speaker and headset amplifier support, with the driver and Devicetree patches totaling about 3,100 lines.
items.summary_zh: Linux 7.3 已发布，Asahi Linux 仍在持续将 Apple Silicon 支持代码合并到上游。本周期有两个重要驱动加入上游工作：macaudio 和 avd。为了准备 macaudio，项目对 ALSA 进行了大量修改，也改造了 Apple 扬声器和耳机放大器的支持；相关驱动与设备树补丁共约 3100 行。

items.title_en: Running a law firm on Free software
items.title_zh: 用自由软件运营一家律师事务所
items.summary_en: Neil Brown describes running decoded.legal, a small English law firm focused on internet, telecommunications, and technology law, with Free software on both the client and server sides. He began doing so around five years ago and has used Free software personally for much longer. The account presents the firm’s software approach as an ongoing practice.
items.summary_zh: Neil Brown 介绍了如何在客户端和服务器端都使用自由软件，运营 decoded.legal 这家专注于互联网、电信和科技法律的小型英格兰律师事务所。他大约五年前开始这样做，而个人使用自由软件的时间更久。这篇文章记录了该事务所持续采用这一软件方式的实践。

items.title_en: A Jev that can ask Opus for help gives Opus accuracy at 4x lower cost
items.title_zh: 能向 Opus 求助的 Jev，让 Opus 以低四倍成本达到同等准确率
items.summary_en: Tests of Jev and GPT-6 Luna as judges for identity resolution found out-of-the-box accuracy ranging from 88.8% to 97.3%. A hybrid that combines Jev with Claude Opus matched frontier-level accuracy at more than four times lower cost. Identity resolution maps data records to unique real-world people.
items.summary_zh: 对 Jev 和 GPT-6 Luna 作为身份解析评判器的测试显示，它们开箱即用的准确率为 88.8% 至 97.3%。将 Jev 与 Claude Opus 结合的混合方案达到了前沿模型水平的准确率，而成本降低了四倍以上。身份解析的任务是将数据记录映射到现实世界中唯一的个人。

items.title_en: How Long Can Life Wait?
items.title_zh: 生命还能等待多久？
items.summary_en: The piece asks how long life can wait. No further details are available here about the subject or argument.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨“生命还能等待多久”这一问题。现有信息未提供更多主题或论点细节。

items.title_en: Five memorable books about programming (2008)
items.title_zh: 五本令人难忘的编程书
items.summary_en: The author frames programming books as tools for turning ideas into working implementations rather than as technology for its own sake. After reading classics such as Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs and Paradigms of Artificial Intelligence Programming, the author chooses to focus on less conventional books that influenced their thinking. The selection therefore emphasizes intellectual impact over canonical status.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，编程书籍的价值不在于技术本身，而在于帮助读者把想法实现出来。在读过《计算机程序的构造和解释》和《人工智能编程范式》等经典之后，作者选择介绍一些影响了自己思考方式、但不那么主流的书。这个书单因此更看重思想影响，而非经典地位。

items.title_en: Terry Pratchett's Study
items.title_zh: 特里·普拉切特的书房
items.summary_en: This project is not an exact replica of Terry Pratchett’s study because the creator lacked photographs from every angle and precise measurements. Instead, it depicts a small section of a study where Pratchett might have felt at home, built at 1:12 scale. The miniature is connected to the childhood imagination associated with The Borrowers.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目并不是特里·普拉切特书房的精确复制品，因为作者没有各个角度的照片和准确尺寸。它展现的是一个可能令普拉切特感到亲切的书房局部，比例为 1:12。这个微缩场景还联系到了《借东西的小人》带来的童年想象。

items.title_en: Commodore PET – The Worlds First Personal Computer
items.title_zh: Commodore PET——世界上第一台个人电脑
items.summary_en: The Commodore PET is presented as the world's first personal computer.
items.summary_zh: Commodore PET 被称为世界上第一台个人电脑。

items.title_en: Every processor die anyone has photographed and given away
items.title_zh: 所有被拍摄并公开的处理器裸片
items.summary_en: The collection contains microscope photographs of 356 processor dies made between 1972 and 2024 and released for public use. A processor die is the flat silicon piece inside a chip package, which must be exposed by sanding or dissolving the package before imaging. A true-scale view is available for the 114 dies whose dimensions are known, showing the size difference between older and modern chips.
items.summary_zh: 这个收藏包含 356 张处理器裸片的显微镜照片，时间跨度从 1972 年到 2024 年，并向公众开放使用。处理器裸片是芯片封装内部的扁平硅片，需要打磨或溶解封装后才能进行拍摄。对于已知尺寸的 114 个裸片，页面还提供真实比例视图，展示老芯片与现代芯片的尺寸差异。

items.title_en: Blender's UI and Runtime: Much Faster Than GPUI
items.title_zh: Blender 的 UI 与运行时：比 GPUI 快得多
items.summary_en: BUI is a GPU-accelerated Blender user interface decoupled from Blender's original codebase. It supports Rust, Python, JavaScript, React, C, and C++. The project describes its performance as twice that of GPUI.
items.summary_zh: BUI 是一个与 Blender 原始代码库解耦的 GPU 加速用户界面。它支持 Rust、Python、JavaScript、React、C 和 C++。项目方称其性能是 GPUI 的两倍。

items.title_en: Consumer brain wave headsets threaten privacy
items.title_zh: 面向消费者的脑电波耳机威胁隐私
items.summary_en: Consumer brain-wave headsets threaten privacy by collecting users' brain data.
items.summary_zh: 面向消费者的脑电波耳机通过收集用户的脑部数据，对隐私构成威胁。

items.title_en: Dutch 'idealist' bank ASN blocks non-Google Android, including GrapheneOS
items.title_zh: 荷兰“理想主义”银行 ASN 屏蔽非 Google Android，包括 GrapheneOS
items.summary_en: A compatibility report examines whether the ASN Bank Android app blocks non-Google Android systems, including GrapheneOS. The report identifies app version 2.40.2 in the Netherlands. One user reported that the app appeared to work on a stock operating system.
items.summary_zh: 一份兼容性报告调查 ASN Bank 的 Android 应用是否屏蔽包括 GrapheneOS 在内的非 Google Android 系统。报告涉及荷兰地区的 2.40.2 版本。一名用户表示，该应用在原生操作系统上看起来可以正常运行。

items.title_en: The End of AI Frontiers
items.title_zh: AI Frontiers 的终结
items.summary_en: After ChatGPT’s release in 2023, John Langford and colleagues formed AI Frontiers within Microsoft Research to organize AI research more coherently. The roughly 50-person group used a middle ground between top-down and bottom-up organization, while dealing with disagreements and frequent compute bottlenecks. Langford said he believed the group was succeeding at pioneering work despite its small size, although the excerpt ends before describing its closure.
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT 于 2023 年发布后，约翰·兰福德与同事在微软研究院内部组建了 AI Frontiers，以更有组织地推进人工智能研究。这个约 50 人的团队采取介于自上而下和自下而上之间的组织方式，同时面临内部分歧和计算资源瓶颈。兰福德认为，尽管规模较小，该团队仍在开展开创性工作，但所给内容尚未说明其后续解散经过。

items.title_en: A barbarian tribe's mythic origin story is true, ancient DNA reveals
items.title_zh: 古代 DNA 揭示：一个“蛮族”部落的神话起源故事是真的
items.summary_en: Ancient DNA reveals that a barbarian tribe’s mythic origin story is true.
items.summary_zh: 古代 DNA 证据显示，一个“蛮族”部落关于自身起源的神话故事确有事实依据。

items.title_en: Ask HN: How did you convince family and friends to join your XMPP/Matrix server?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：你是如何说服家人和朋友加入 XMPP/Matrix 服务器的？
items.summary_en: The author asks how people persuaded family and friends to move from SMS or WhatsApp to self-hosted XMPP or Matrix messaging. Their contacts mainly value ease of use, reliability, and fun features, while the author finds many existing clients difficult to use and poorly suited as simple SMS replacements. The discussion centers on the practical and user-experience barriers to adopting open messaging protocols.
items.summary_zh: 提问者想知道，大家是如何说服家人和朋友从短信或 WhatsApp 转向自托管的 XMPP 或 Matrix 消息服务的。提问者的亲友主要看重易用性、可靠性和有趣的功能，而提问者认为许多现有客户端难用，也不适合作为简单的短信替代品。讨论的核心是开放消息协议在实际采用和用户体验方面面临的障碍。

items.title_en: Ex-PlayStation boss says "true innovation" would be making a $300 console again
items.title_zh: 前 PlayStation 负责人称，真正的创新是再次推出 300 美元的游戏主机
items.summary_en: Former PlayStation executive Shawn Layden said the company should do something it has never done. The proposed form of "true innovation" is to make a $300 console again.
items.summary_zh: 前 PlayStation 高管 Shawn Layden 表示，公司应该做一件从未做过的事。他所提出的“真正创新”是再次推出售价 300 美元的游戏主机。

items.title_en: The Components of Agent Memory
items.title_zh: 智能体记忆的组成部分
items.summary_en: It compares this process with human memory consolidation, in which experiences are captured continuously but only some become long-term knowledge. The proposed “dreaming” process helps organize memories and correct mistakes.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨 Claude 这类 AI 智能体如何在尚不知道未来会发生什么时，判断哪些经历值得记住。它将这一过程与人类记忆巩固进行比较：人类持续记录经历，但只有一部分会成为长期知识。文中提出的“做梦”过程用于整理记忆并纠正错误。

items.title_en: Show HN: Where Were We
items.title_zh: Show HN：我们曾在哪里
items.summary_en: Where Were We turns vacation photos into a shareable web game. It uses EXIF metadata to determine where and when each photo was taken, then builds the game from that information.
items.summary_zh: Where Were We 可以把旅行照片制作成可分享的网页游戏。它利用照片的 EXIF 元数据判断拍摄地点和时间，再据此生成游戏。

items.title_en: Firecracker VM Escape: PwnEscape Part 2
items.title_zh: Firecracker 虚拟机逃逸：PwnEscape 第二部分
items.summary_en: The item covers a Firecracker virtual-machine escape under the title PwnEscape Part 2.
items.summary_zh: 该项目介绍了题为“PwnEscape 第二部分”的 Firecracker 虚拟机逃逸内容。

items.title_en: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
items.title_zh: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
items.summary_en: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash adds native generation and editing of 15-second videos. The release also promises stronger consistency and faster, more cost-effective generation. Its pricing is 30% lower.
items.summary_zh: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 新增原生的 15 秒视频生成与编辑能力。此次更新还提升了一致性，并带来更快、更具成本效益的生成体验。其价格降低了 30%。

items.title_en: GeoWorks, Microsoft Windows' Upstart '90s Competitor (2016)
items.title_zh: GeoWorks：微软 Windows 在 90 年代的后起竞争者
items.summary_en: GeoWorks was a 1990s upstart competitor to Microsoft Windows, with AOL also involved.
items.summary_zh: GeoWorks 是 20 世纪 90 年代挑战微软 Windows 的新兴竞争者，AOL 也参与其中。

items.title_en: IRA Velinsky – Commodore's Industrial Designer
items.title_zh: 艾拉·维林斯基——Commodore 的工业设计师
items.summary_en: Ira Velinsky was Commodore's industrial designer.
items.summary_zh: 艾拉·维林斯基是 Commodore 的工业设计师。

items.title_en: ISponsorBlockTV: SponsorBlock client for all YouTube TV clients
items.title_zh: iSponsorBlockTV：适用于所有 YouTube TV 客户端的 SponsorBlock 客户端
items.summary_en: iSponsorBlockTV is a self-hosted application that connects to the YouTube TV app and automatically skips sponsored segments and intros using the SponsorBlock API. It can also mute videos automatically and press YouTube's "Skip Ad" button when it appears. YouTube appears to have changed its screen-ID format and is revoking existing codes, so devices must be paired again.
items.summary_zh: iSponsorBlockTV 是一款自托管应用，可连接 YouTube TV 客户端，并通过 SponsorBlock API 自动跳过赞助片段和片头。它还可以自动静音，并在 YouTube 广告出现“跳过广告”按钮后自动点击。YouTube 似乎更改了屏幕 ID 格式并正在撤销现有代码，因此设备需要重新配对。

items.title_en: Show HN: An offline desktop companion to help maintain a healthy blink rhythm
items.title_zh: Show HN：帮助保持健康眨眼节律的离线桌面助手
items.summary_en: EyesRhythm is an offline desktop tool that gives audio and visual cues to help users maintain a healthy blinking rhythm. It detects blinks locally using one or more webcams, records neck movement, and requires no internet connection. The project is aimed at people whose prolonged screen work can reduce blink frequency and contribute to dry, painful eyes.
items.summary_zh: EyesRhythm 是一款离线桌面工具，通过音频和视觉提示帮助用户保持健康的眨眼节律。它使用一台或多台摄像头在本地检测眨眼、记录颈部运动，并且无需联网。该项目面向长时间使用屏幕、可能因眨眼频率下降而出现干眼和疼痛的人群。

items.title_en: Show HN: We compressed a 31B video+audio diffusion model to 14B, 6 steps, INT8
items.title_zh: Show HN：将 31B 视频音频扩散模型压缩至 14B、6 步、INT8
items.summary_en: HyperFlow H3 Flash is a compressed, few-step version of MiniMax-H3 with 13.7 billion parameters. It generates video and synchronized stereo audio together and supports INT8 and GGUF formats. The project also provides weights, ComfyUI nodes, a GGUF setup guide, and an eight-step LoRA for the full-size model.
items.summary_zh: HyperFlow H3 Flash 是 MiniMax-H3 的压缩少步数版本，包含 137 亿个参数。它能够同时生成视频和同步立体声，并支持 INT8 与 GGUF 格式。项目还提供模型权重、ComfyUI 节点、GGUF 配置指南，以及适用于完整模型的 8 步 LoRA。

items.title_en: Retro Song Bird: Plug in any Game Boy cartridge to hear the soundtrack
items.title_zh: Retro Song Bird：插入任意 Game Boy 卡带，聆听游戏配乐
items.summary_en: Retro Song Bird lets users relive classic-game soundtracks by plugging in a Game Boy cartridge. It supports more than 1,900 games.
items.summary_zh: Retro Song Bird 允许用户插入 Game Boy 卡带，重温经典游戏的配乐。它支持超过 1,900 款游戏。

items.title_en: US FAA says it will phase out floppy disks from air traffic control by 2028
items.title_zh: 美国 FAA 将在 2028 年前逐步淘汰空管系统中的软盘
items.summary_en: The US Federal Aviation Administration plans to phase out floppy disks from its air-traffic-control systems by 2028. The move will replace a legacy storage technology still used in parts of air-traffic operations.
items.summary_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局计划在 2028 年前逐步淘汰空中交通管制系统中的软盘。这一举措将替换部分航空交通运营中仍在使用的老旧存储技术。

items.title_en: First steps in bare-metal programming using UEFI
items.title_zh: 使用 UEFI 开始裸机编程
items.summary_en: This series teaches bare-metal programming for x86 PCs using UEFI firmware and Linux as the development environment. It covers the required tools, compilation and linking, bootable disk creation, and basic file management. The series is aimed at experienced Linux developers but assumes no prior UEFI knowledge. The articles should be read in order because later installments depend on earlier material.
items.summary_zh: 这一系列文章介绍如何以 Linux 为开发环境、使用 UEFI 固件为 x86 PC 编写裸机程序。内容涵盖所需工具、编译与链接、创建可启动磁盘以及基本文件管理。文章面向有经验的 Linux 开发者，但不要求读者事先了解 UEFI。由于后文依赖前文内容，作者建议按顺序阅读。

items.title_en: GitHub's new Git storage architecture
items.title_zh: GitHub 的新 Git 存储架构
items.summary_en: GitHub has built a new Git storage architecture designed to let thousands of agents push to a single repository at the same time. The architecture describes how GitHub supports this concurrent access pattern.
items.summary_zh: GitHub 构建了一套新的 Git 存储架构，目标是让数千个代理同时向同一个仓库推送代码。该架构介绍了 GitHub 如何支持这种并发访问模式。

items.title_en: RealPage rent-pricing case wraps with nearly $360M to renters
items.title_zh: RealPage 租金定价案和解，租户获近 3.6 亿美元
items.summary_en: A federal court approved settlements in the antitrust case over algorithmic rent setting through RealPage software. The court found the settlements, including the payment amounts, releases, and dismissal of the case against settling defendants, fair and adequate for the settling class. A legal expert cautioned that the approval may not be the final word in litigation over algorithmic pricing.
items.summary_zh: 联邦法院批准了围绕 RealPage 软件算法定租的反垄断诉讼和解。法院认定，和解金额、责任解除以及对和解被告的诉讼终结安排，对参与和解的集体成员而言公平且充分。一名法律专家提醒，这可能并不是算法定价诉讼的最终结论。

items.title_en: Microsoft Removes PC-to-PC Migration from Windows 11, Pushes Users to OneDrive
items.title_zh: 微软从 Windows 11 中移除电脑到电脑迁移功能，推动用户使用 OneDrive
items.summary_en: Windows 11 no longer offers direct PC-to-PC file transfers, and Microsoft now directs users to Windows Backup. An updated Microsoft support page says the PC-to-PC Migration feature is no longer available. The removal began with the September optional update KB5124010 and reached regular users in the October 13, 2026 Patch Tuesday update, KB5127648.
items.summary_zh: Windows 11 不再提供电脑之间的直接文件传输，微软现在引导用户使用 Windows Backup。微软更新后的支持页面表示，PC-to-PC Migration 功能已不再可用。该功能从 9 月的可选更新 KB5124010 开始被移除，并在 2026 年 10 月 13 日的补丁星期二更新 KB5127648 中面向普通用户下线。

items.title_en: The Gordon Gekko Effect: The Role of Culture in the Financial Industry [pdf] (2016)
items.title_zh: 戈登·盖柯效应：文化在金融业中的作用（2016）
items.summary_en: The paper examines the role of culture in the financial industry under the title “The Gordon Gekko Effect.” No further findings or methods are established by the available information.
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文以“戈登·盖柯效应”为题，研究文化在金融业中的作用。现有信息未提供更多研究方法或结论。

items.title_en: We know 15k websites are infected. how do we tell them?
items.title_zh: 我们知道有 1.5 万个网站被感染，如何通知它们？
items.summary_en: Researchers identified 15,579 websites currently infected with malicious JavaScript. Together, the sites are conservatively estimated to receive more than 135 million visits per month. The researchers say they have evidence of the infections but face the practical problem of notifying all the affected site operators.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员发现，目前有 15,579 个网站感染了恶意 JavaScript。这些网站合计每月接收的访问量保守估计超过 1.35 亿次。研究人员表示，他们掌握了感染证据，但面临如何通知所有受影响网站运营者的实际难题。

items.title_en: Shadow of the Sun (2021)
items.title_zh: 太阳的阴影（2021）
items.summary_en: The author reflects on the desire to abandon ordinary work, relationships, property, and stability in order to live as a drifter. Such a life would offer unusual places, adventure, and personal responsibility, but would require giving up safety and conventional sources of happiness. The author compares this imagined existence to the life of Ryszard Kapuscinski.
items.summary_zh: 作者思考了抛弃普通工作、人际关系、财产和稳定生活、成为漂泊者的愿望。这样的生活能够带来陌生的地方、冒险和对自身安全负责的自由，但也意味着放弃安全感与传统意义上的幸福来源。作者将这种想象中的生活与 Ryszard Kapuscinski 的人生相提并论。

items.title_en: Pwn.college
items.title_zh: Pwn.college
items.summary_en: Pwn.college is a free, hands-on education platform for learning core cybersecurity skills. Learners practice through terminal- and systems-oriented challenges while progressing through a belt-based curriculum. The platform is maintained by hackers at Arizona State University and supports the university's cybersecurity teaching as well as participation from learners worldwide.
items.summary_zh: Pwn.college 是一个免费的实践型平台，用于学习网络安全核心技能。学习者通过面向终端和计算机系统的挑战进行练习，并沿着分级腰带课程逐步进阶。该平台由亚利桑那州立大学的黑客团队维护，既服务于该校网络安全教学，也向全球学习者开放。

items.title_en: What should we learn now?
items.title_zh: 我们现在应该学习什么？
items.summary_en: The spread of LLMs that write much of the day's code is prompting developers to reconsider how they learn. The author says LLMs are ubiquitous in their corporate coding environment and views them as a potentially useful tooling improvement. They also argue that poor-quality and hallucinated code existed in large quantities before LLMs arrived.
items.summary_zh: LLM 越来越多地代写日常代码，促使开发者重新思考学习方式。作者表示，LLM 在其所在的企业编程环境中已经无处不在，并认为它们可能是有益的工具改进。作者还指出，在 LLM 出现之前，低质量代码和大量幻觉式结果也早已存在。

items.title_en: Kugelblitz – Mac-Native Google Earth Alternative
items.title_zh: Kugelblitz：原生 Mac 的 Google Earth 替代品
items.summary_en: Kugelblitz is a Mac application that presents Earth and nearby celestial bodies as a 3D globe and atlas. It uses maps and open geodata on real terrain.
items.summary_zh: Kugelblitz 是一款 Mac 应用，将地球及其邻近天体呈现为 3D 地球仪和地图册。它基于真实地形使用地图与开放地理数据。

items.title_en: Devvm.dev: One VM for every project
items.title_zh: Devvm.dev：每个项目一个虚拟机
items.summary_en: Devvm.dev provides an isolated virtual-machine sandbox for each project, with the project's toolchain ready for a developer or coding agent. It is free and open source. The Linux installation script also works on macOS, and the installation process documents its available options.
items.summary_zh: Devvm.dev 为每个项目提供隔离的虚拟机沙箱，并预装项目所需的工具链，供开发者或编程智能体直接开始工作。该工具免费且开源。Linux 安装脚本也可在 macOS 上运行，安装文档列出了可用选项。

items.title_en: Restaurant Delivery Payment-Skimming Campaign
items.title_zh: 餐厅外卖支付盗刷活动
items.summary_en: InfoHawk researchers found a network of 820 suspicious restaurant domains impersonating major US chains including Jersey Mike's, Jimmy John's, Chipotle, and Dave's Hot Chicken. Some sites use payment-skimming attacks to capture card details and request bank SMS verification codes. The investigation began in early November 2026 and identified what appear to be coordinated restaurant-impersonation operations.
items.summary_zh: InfoHawk 研究人员发现了一个由 820 个可疑餐厅域名组成的网络，这些域名冒充 Jersey Mike's、Jimmy John's、Chipotle 和 Dave's Hot Chicken 等美国连锁品牌。部分网站通过支付盗刷攻击窃取银行卡信息，并要求用户提供银行短信验证码。调查于 2026 年 11 月初展开，这些网站疑似属于协调运作的餐厅冒充和支付盗刷活动。

items.title_en: You are protesting the wrong technology, people
items.title_zh: 人们抗议错了技术
items.summary_en: The piece argues that people are directing their protests at the wrong technology. No further details about the technology or the argument are established here.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章认为，人们把抗议矛头指向了错误的技术。现有信息未说明具体涉及哪种技术或论据。

items.title_en: Notes on San Marino
items.title_zh: 圣马力诺札记
items.summary_en: The writer spent three days in San Marino, a landlocked microstate completely surrounded by Italy. Its people are known as the Sammarinese. The notes contrast the travel experience in European microstates with the more unsolicited encounters the writer describes in Afghanistan.
items.summary_zh: 作者在圣马力诺度过了三天；这是一个完全被意大利包围的内陆微型国家，其居民称为 Sammarinese（圣马力诺人）。文章将欧洲微型国家的旅行体验，与作者在阿富汗所描述的更多非预期人际接触进行了对比。

items.title_en: The AI sell-off compared to well-known stock market crashes
items.title_zh: 将 AI 抛售与知名股市崩盘相比较
items.summary_en: The S&P 500 fell 4.4% on November 5, 2026, its worst day since April 2025, and stood 6% below its October 6 record. The Nasdaq had fallen 11%, while chip stocks were down 36%, comparable to their 35% decline during the COVID-19 crash. Compared with major historical market crashes, the S&P 500’s recent 6% decline is described as a mild correction.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年 11 月 5 日，标普 500 指数下跌 4.4%，创 2025 年 4 月以来最差单日表现，较 10 月 6 日的纪录高点低 6%。纳斯达克指数下跌 11%，芯片股下跌 36%，接近其在新冠疫情崩盘期间 35% 的跌幅。与历史上主要的市场崩盘相比，标普 500 最近 6% 的回落被描述为一次温和修正。

items.title_en: Living beyond the limits of survival: wood ants trapped in a gigantic pitfall (2016)
items.title_zh: 活过生存极限：困在巨大陷阱中的木蚁（2016）
items.summary_en: Researchers documented a large accumulation of Formica polyctena worker ants trapped inside a former nuclear-weapons bunker. The ants fell through a ventilation pipe and could not return to their outdoor colony, so they built and maintained an earthen nest in complete darkness. The bunker population has survived for years and now numbers in the hundreds of thousands, sustained by newly fallen workers. It has produced no offspring because of the low temperatures and limited food supply.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员记录了 Formica polyctena 工蚁在一座旧核武器仓库内形成的大规模聚集。这些蚂蚁从通风管道掉入后无法返回室外的母巢，于是在完全黑暗中建造并维护土制巢穴。这个地下种群已存活多年，目前数量达到数十万，依靠外部蚁群不断掉落的新工蚁维持。由于温度较低且食物有限，它们没有繁殖后代。

items.title_en: We've built an open-source feature flag server for 11 years
items.title_zh: 我们打造开源功能开关服务器已有 11 年
items.summary_en: Unleash is an open-source feature-management platform that lets teams control when and how new features are released. It supports smaller, more manageable production deployments and can streamline software delivery. The project has been developed for 11 years.
items.summary_zh: Unleash 是一个开源功能管理平台，让团队控制新功能何时以及如何向用户发布。它支持更小、更易管理的生产部署，并可简化软件交付流程。该项目已开发 11 年。

items.title_en: America's economy is becoming zero-sum
items.title_zh: 美国经济正变成零和经济
items.summary_en: The piece argues that America’s economy is becoming zero-sum. No further details about the causes or examples are established here.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章认为，美国经济正在变成零和经济。现有信息未提供具体原因或例证。

items.title_en: Show HN: Maple – Sub-2-BPW Moe Pruning to Run Gemma 4 26B at 45 TPS on a 6GB GPU
items.title_zh: Show HN：Maple——次于 2 BPW 的 MoE 剪枝，让 Gemma 4 26B 在 6GB GPU 上达到 45 TPS
items.summary_en: Maple is a structural-compression method for mixture-of-experts language models. It compresses Gemma 4 26B-A4B from 9.92 GB to 4.75 GB, equivalent to 1.48 effective bits per parameter. The project reports 100% in-VRAM execution on 6 GB laptop GPUs at 45.4 tokens per second.
items.summary_zh: Maple 是一种面向混合专家语言模型的结构化压缩方法。它将 Gemma 4 26B-A4B 从 9.92 GB 压缩到 4.75 GB，相当于每参数 1.48 个有效比特。项目报告称，该模型可在 6GB 笔记本 GPU 上完全载入显存运行，速度达到每秒 45.4 个 token。

items.title_en: Chomsky and the two cultures of statistical learning (2011)
items.title_zh: 乔姆斯基与统计学习的两种文化（2011）
items.summary_en: The essay responds to Steven Pinker’s question about why probabilistic models trained with statistical methods have been successful. It examines Chomsky’s objections that statistical language models may have engineering value without providing scientific principles or insight into language. It also considers what statistical models are, how successful they have been, and whether their success resembles progress in science.
items.summary_zh: 文章回应了 Steven Pinker 关于统计方法训练的概率模型为何能够成功的问题。文章考察了乔姆斯基的批评：统计语言模型或许具有工程价值，却未必揭示语言背后的科学原理或提供真正洞见。文章还讨论统计模型的定义、语言模型的成功程度，以及这种成功是否类似于科学进步。

items.title_en: Fox Bought Roku
items.title_zh: 福克斯收购 Roku
items.summary_en: Fox has completed its $22 billion acquisition of Roku. The deal gives Fox control of Roku’s streaming platform, which reaches more than 100 million US households. The acquisition could lead to more Fox content appearing on Roku.
items.summary_zh: 福克斯已完成对 Roku 的 220 亿美元收购。交易使福克斯获得 Roku 流媒体平台的控制权，该平台覆盖美国超过 1 亿户家庭。这一收购可能会让 Roku 上出现更多福克斯内容。

items.title_en: Cancer at Sea
items.title_zh: 海上癌症
items.summary_en: A mysterious disease affecting California sea lions is being studied to better understand cancer in animals, including humans. Researchers at the Marine Mammal Center examined a sea lion pup that was severely malnourished and only about one-quarter the size of a healthy pup. The young male survived for ten days after arriving but could not be saved.
items.summary_zh: 一种影响加州海狮的神秘疾病，正在帮助科学家更好地理解包括人类在内的动物癌症。海洋哺乳动物中心的研究人员检查了一只严重营养不良的海狮幼崽，它的体型只有健康幼崽的大约四分之一。这只雄性幼崽抵达后存活了 10 天，但最终未能获救。

items.title_en: Greece has its own Pompeii: Thera buried Akrotiri in ash 17th-16th century BCE
items.title_zh: 希腊版庞贝：Thera 在公元前 17 至 16 世纪以火山灰掩埋 Akrotiri
items.summary_en: The Thera volcano on modern-day Santorini buried the Bronze Age settlement of Akrotiri in ash during the 17th or 16th century BCE. After earthquakes and eruptions, residents first fled by boat, returned to gather materials and repair damage, and then evacuated again as conditions worsened. The eruption was one of the largest in recorded history.
items.summary_zh: 位于今圣托里尼的 Thera 火山在公元前 17 或 16 世纪喷发，以火山灰掩埋了青铜时代聚落 Akrotiri。地震和喷发后，居民先乘船逃离，随后返回收集材料、修复受损建筑；情况恶化后，他们再次撤离。这次喷发是有记录以来规模最大的喷发之一。

items.title_en: Uranium cubes reveal why the German nuclear project failed
items.title_zh: 铀立方体揭示德国核项目失败的原因
items.summary_en: Research challenges Werner Heisenberg's claim that Germany's wartime reactor project was close to criticality and only needed slightly more uranium. The study concludes that, under the design used for the B8 pile, the German program lacked enough uranium and heavy water to build a working bomb. The research began after physicist Timothy Koeth received a mysterious heavy-metal cube in 2013 and recognized it as one of the uranium cubes used by German scientists. Only 14 such cubes are known to exist today.
items.summary_zh: 研究质疑了维尔纳·海森堡关于德国战时反应堆项目接近达到临界、只需更多一点铀的说法。研究认为，按照 B8 反应堆采用的设计，德国项目缺乏制造可运行核装置所需的足量铀和重水。这项研究始于 2013 年，当时物理学家蒂莫西·科特收到一个神秘的重金属立方体，并认出它是德国科学家使用过的铀立方体之一。目前已知仅存 14 个这样的立方体。

items.title_en: What do the next 4000 emoji look like?
items.title_zh: 未来 4000 个 emoji 会是什么样？
items.summary_en: The piece asks what the next 4,000 emoji might look like.
items.summary_zh: 文章提出了一个问题：未来 4000 个 emoji 可能会是什么样子。

items.title_en: Air holes turn silicon wafers into flat UV focusing mirrors for compact optics
items.title_zh: 气孔将硅晶圆变成用于紧凑光学系统的平面紫外聚焦镜
items.summary_en: The research describes using air holes in silicon wafers to create flat ultraviolet-focusing mirrors. Metasurfaces can control the phase of light with nanoscale structures, but extending them into the ultraviolet is difficult because many metasurface materials strongly absorb UV light. The approach could support compact systems for high-resolution imaging, spectroscopy, and sensing.
items.summary_zh: 这项研究介绍了利用硅晶圆中的气孔制造平面紫外聚焦镜。超表面可以通过纳米结构控制光的相位，但许多超表面材料会强烈吸收紫外光，使其向紫外波段扩展十分困难。这种方法有望用于高分辨率成像、光谱分析和传感等紧凑型系统。

items.title_en: Datastructures-JS – The JavaScript data structures project
items.title_zh: Datastructures-JS：JavaScript 数据结构项目
items.summary_en: Datastructures-JS is a JavaScript data-structures project with TypeScript support. The project also provides an associated planning board.
items.summary_zh: Datastructures-JS 是一个支持 TypeScript 的 JavaScript 数据结构项目。项目还提供了配套的规划看板。

items.title_en: The planet Vulcan: a cautionary tale
items.title_zh: 行星 Vulcan：一个警示故事
items.summary_en: Vulcan was a proposed planet inside Mercury’s orbit that astronomers first reportedly observed in 1859 and continued to report for roughly four decades. Its properties were described in detail, although scientists are now convinced that the planet does not exist and the observations remain unexplained. The episode illustrates how confident scientific conclusions can later be overturned through falsification.
items.summary_zh: Vulcan 是一颗被认为位于水星轨道以内的假想行星，据称于 1859 年首次被观测到，此后约四十年间不断出现相关报告。天文学家甚至详细描述了它的性质，但如今科学界确信这颗行星并不存在，而当时究竟观测到了什么仍是未解之谜。这个案例说明，充满信心的科学结论也可能通过证伪最终被推翻。

items.title_en: Show HN: Waymark – A workflow engine that compiles jobs instead of replaying
items.title_zh: Show HN：Waymark——编译任务而非重放任务的工作流引擎
items.summary_en: Waymark is an open-source durable execution library similar to Temporal or DBOS. It lets developers write workflows in ordinary Python code using conditionals, loops, and asyncio-style parallelism, while the runtime handles distributed execution. Rather than replaying past state in an interpreter, Waymark walks the program’s AST and compiles the logic into bytecode for a stackless virtual machine.
items.summary_zh: Waymark 是一个类似 Temporal 或 DBOS 的开源持久执行库。开发者可以用普通 Python 代码编写工作流，包括条件语句、循环和类似 asyncio 的并行操作，再由运行时负责分布式执行。Waymark 不通过解释器重放历史状态，而是遍历程序 AST，将逻辑编译为运行在无栈虚拟机上的字节码。

items.title_en: The great butter and cheese fire of 1991
items.title_zh: 1991 年那场巨大的黄油与奶酪火灾
items.summary_en: The subject is the great butter and cheese fire of 1991, in which more than 20 million pounds of commodities were lost.
items.summary_zh: 主题是 1991 年那场巨大的黄油与奶酪火灾，当时有超过 2000 万磅商品损失。

items.title_en: Show HN: Spindle – a full-featured, type-safe web framework for OCaml 5
items.title_zh: Show HN：Spindle，面向 OCaml 5 的全功能类型安全 Web 框架
items.summary_en: Spindle is a multicore-by-design, Eio-native web framework for OCaml that uses a type-driven API to derive codecs, request validation, OpenAPI specifications, and frontend schemas. It includes an RFC-strict HTTP server, WebSockets, SSE, MCP server primitives, tracing, metrics, and logging. Its benchmarks report performance two times faster than NestJS and five times faster than FastAPI on a single core, although speed was not the project’s primary goal.
items.summary_zh: Spindle 是一个面向多核设计、原生支持 Eio 的 OCaml Web 框架，通过类型驱动的 API 自动生成编解码器、请求验证、OpenAPI 规范和前端模式。它包含严格遵循 RFC 的 HTTP 服务器、WebSocket、SSE、MCP 服务器基础组件，以及分布式追踪、指标和日志功能。基准测试显示，它在单核上运行速度约为 NestJS 的两倍、FastAPI 的五倍，不过速度并非项目的首要目标。

items.title_en: Yes, You Can Pass a Nuclear Missile Driving on Interstate 80 Through Wyoming
items.title_zh: 是的，你可以驾驶汽车沿怀俄明州 80 号州际公路运送核导弹
items.summary_en: Military-escorted semitrailers traveling on Interstate 80 through Wyoming may carry nuclear missiles. Driver Roberto Figueroa became curious after seeing a uniquely shaped trailer accompanied by armored vehicles and helicopters near Burns. The convoy's appearance prompted questions about what was being transported.
items.summary_zh: 在怀俄明州 80 号州际公路上行驶、由军方护送的半挂车可能运输核导弹。司机 Roberto Figueroa 在 Burns 附近看到一辆外形独特的拖车，周围还有装甲车和头顶的直升机，因此产生了疑问。这支车队的外观引发了人们对其运输内容的猜测。

items.title_en: Can GROUP BY still be optimized after all these years?
items.title_zh: GROUP BY 这么多年后还能继续优化吗？
items.summary_en: Pivot introduced an optimization for GROUP BY queries with a Top-K operator above them, significantly improving performance when finding the groups with the highest aggregate values. The example query is finding the 10 items with the most orders. The walkthrough also explains how analytical databases execute GROUP BY operations.
items.summary_zh: Pivot 为带有 Top-K 运算符的 GROUP BY 查询引入了一项优化，在寻找聚合值最高的分组时显著提升了性能。示例查询是找出订单量最多的 10 个商品。文章还讲解了分析型数据库如何执行 GROUP BY。

items.title_en: The Flash C Compiler
items.title_zh: Flash C 编译器
items.summary_en: Flash C is a C compiler.
items.summary_zh: Flash C 是一个 C 编译器。

items.title_en: Text.js: Build full-stack React apps that render inside console.log
items.title_zh: Text.js：让全栈 React 应用渲染在 console.log 中
items.summary_en: Text.js is a React framework for building full-stack applications that render inside the browser’s DevTools console. Its page itself runs in the console and provides keyboard shortcuts for opening developer tools. The framework presents console rendering as an alternative interface for React applications.
items.summary_zh: Text.js 是一个 React 框架，用于构建渲染在浏览器开发者工具控制台中的全栈应用。它的页面本身也会在控制台中运行，并提供打开开发者工具的快捷键。该框架将控制台渲染作为 React 应用的一种替代界面。

items.title_en: ToothPaste
items.title_zh: ToothPaste
items.summary_en: ToothPaste wirelessly transmits AES-256-encrypted keyboard and mouse commands to USB-compatible devices. It uses Web Bluetooth, a cryptographic IC, and an ESP32-S3, without requiring specialized drivers or extensive setup. The project is designed for cross-platform device control.
items.summary_zh: ToothPaste 可将经过 AES-256 加密的键盘和鼠标指令无线传输到兼容 USB 的设备。它使用 Web Bluetooth、加密芯片和 ESP32-S3，无需专用驱动或复杂配置。该项目面向跨平台设备控制。

items.title_en: PostgreSQL Internals [pdf] (2023)
items.title_zh: PostgreSQL 内部机制（2023）
items.summary_en: This is a 2023 PDF about PostgreSQL internals. No further coverage or specific topics are established by the available information.
items.summary_zh: 这是一本 2023 年出版的 PostgreSQL 内部机制 PDF。现有信息未提供更多内容或具体主题。

items.title_en: 8088 Domination Post-Mortem
items.title_zh: 《8088 Domination》事后复盘
items.summary_en: The write-up explains how the author created 8088 Domination, a program capable of displaying full-motion video on a 1981 IBM PC. The production runs on an IBM PC 5150 connected to a television through its composite output. It can also be downloaded and run on vintage hardware to verify the demonstration.
items.summary_zh: 这篇复盘介绍了作者如何制作《8088 Domination》，一款能够在 1981 年的 IBM PC 上播放全动态视频的程序。该作品可在通过复合视频输出连接电视的 IBM PC 5150 上运行。读者还可以下载它，在老式硬件上运行以验证演示效果。

items.title_en: The typo generation is damaging literature
items.title_zh: 错别字一代正在损害文学
items.summary_en: The discussion concerns Percival Everett’s The Trees and the problem of errors in contemporary books. One response agrees that frustrating typos are common in modern publishing but disputes claims about how certain literary passages should be interpreted. The response specifically questions treating invented lynching victims with real names and a broadcast transcript as straightforward mistakes.
items.summary_zh: 这场讨论围绕珀西瓦尔·埃弗里特的《树》和当代书籍中的错误展开。一位回应者同意现代出版物中令人困扰的错别字很常见，但不同意对某些文学段落的解读。回应特别质疑把使用真实姓名的虚构私刑受害者，以及一段广播文字稿，直接视为错误的说法。

items.title_en: British Library Legal deposit and web archiving
items.title_zh: 英国图书馆的法定缴存与网络存档
items.summary_en: The British Library and other legal deposit libraries are legally entitled to copy UK-published material from the internet for archival purposes. The page explains how they identify UK websites and describes the restrictions that apply to legal-deposit web archiving. The framework extends legal deposit practices to online material.
items.summary_zh: 大英图书馆及其他法定缴存图书馆依法有权复制互联网上在英国出版的材料，用于存档。该页面说明了它们如何识别英国网站，以及网络法定缴存存档所受的限制。这套制度将法定缴存实践延伸到了在线材料。

items.title_en: Building the NBC News Big Board
items.title_zh: 构建 NBC News 的选举“大看板”
items.summary_en: The NBC News Big Board began as a touchscreen prototype for exploring county-level election results and later became the on-air display used by Steve Kornacki. Michael Small and the author built it with NBC News Digital’s product and technology teams for live broadcasts watched by about 10 million people. The system had to support last-minute scorecard filters while leaving no room for errors during live election coverage.
items.summary_zh: NBC News 的选举“大看板”最初是一个用于浏览县级选举结果的触摸屏原型，后来成为 Steve Kornacki 在节目中使用的直播显示系统。作者与 Michael Small 及 NBC News Digital 的产品和技术团队共同完成了它，直播时约有 1000 万人观看。系统还必须支持临时添加计分卡筛选条件，同时在选举直播中几乎不能出错。

items.title_en: Tasfer: a text editor drawn on a 2D canvas
items.title_zh: Tasfer：绘制在二维画布上的文本编辑器
items.summary_en: Tasfer is an open-source web text editor built on a 2D canvas instead of contentEditable. It includes peer-to-peer collaboration and requires no accounts. The author chose this approach to avoid contentEditable’s browser-dependent HTML changes, selection problems, and messy paste behavior.
items.summary_zh: Tasfer 是一个开源网页文本编辑器，使用二维画布构建，而不是依赖 contentEditable。它支持点对点协作，且无需账户。作者采用这种方式，是为了避开 contentEditable 带来的浏览器间 HTML 行为差异、光标选择问题和粘贴内容混乱等问题。

items.title_en: Turning every radio into a radar
items.title_zh: 让每台收音机都变成雷达
items.summary_en: The project aims to turn any radio into a radar.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目旨在把任何收音机变成雷达。

items.title_en: Optimising the Rail Cube
items.title_zh: 优化 Rail Cube
items.summary_en: The project is an interactive Rail Cube track that currently displays a prompt for a shape string. It is described as resembling a combination of model trains and LEGO. No optimization results are provided in the available context.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个交互式 Rail Cube 轨道项目，目前会提示用户输入形状字符串。作者将它形容为模型火车与乐高的结合体。现有信息未提供具体的优化结果。

items.title_en: ZeBridge – PostgreSQL replicas on devices, synchronized over NATS
items.title_zh: ZeBridge：通过 NATS 同步设备上的 PostgreSQL 副本
items.summary_en: ZeBridge is a bidirectional, local-first synchronization engine connecting PostgreSQL with edge SQLite, PGLITE, PostgreSQL, and DuckDB clients over NATS. It keeps a local database on each device and queues writes while the device is offline. When connectivity returns, PostgreSQL remains authoritative by applying rules, resolving conflicts, and returning a result to the application.
items.summary_zh: ZeBridge 是一个双向、以本地优先为理念的同步引擎，通过 NATS 连接 PostgreSQL 与边缘端的 SQLite、PGLITE、PostgreSQL 和 DuckDB 客户端。它在每台设备上保留本地数据库，并在离线时排队保存写入操作。重新连接后，PostgreSQL 仍是权威数据源，负责应用规则、解决冲突并向应用返回结果。

items.title_en: Study solved a 150-year-old mystery into the identity of the extinct giant crane
items.title_zh: 研究破解了一桩持续 150 年的灭绝巨鹤身份之谜
items.summary_en: A study has solved a 150-year-old mystery about the identity of an extinct giant crane.
items.summary_zh: 一项研究破解了持续 150 年的灭绝巨鹤身份之谜。

items.title_en: Show HN: Green tests are not proof – verifier for C/C++ and firmware fixes
items.title_zh: Show HN：绿色测试并不等于证明——用于 C/C++ 和固件修复的验证器
items.summary_en: Unfix independently verifies bug fixes in C, C++, and firmware, including fixes produced by AI coding agents. It reproduces the bug, applies the proposed fix, reruns the tests on the user's tests and real hardware, then removes the fix to check whether the bug returns. The system produces one of three verdicts: VERIFIED, REJECTED, or NOT VERIFIABLE. Unfix does not write the code itself.
items.summary_zh: Unfix 可以独立验证 C、C++ 和固件中的错误修复，包括 AI 编程代理生成的修复。它会重现错误、应用修复，在用户提供的测试和真实硬件上重新运行验证，然后移除修复，检查错误是否再次出现。系统会给出三种结论之一：VERIFIED（已验证）、REJECTED（已拒绝）或 NOT VERIFIABLE（无法验证）。Unfix 本身不会编写代码。

items.title_en: Amsterdam School
items.title_zh: 阿姆斯特丹学派
items.summary_en: The Amsterdam School emerged from Eduard Cuypers's atelier during the first decade of the 20th century. Its future leaders included Michel de Klerk, Johann Melchior van der Mey, and Pieter Lodewijk Kramer. The movement combined elements of Jugendstil, Arts and Crafts, Belgian Art Nouveau, 17th-century Dutch architecture, and Indonesian art.
items.summary_zh: 阿姆斯特丹学派于 20 世纪第一个十年从爱德华·柯伊佩斯的工作室中发展起来。其未来的代表人物包括米歇尔·德·克勒克、约翰·梅尔希奥·范·德·梅和彼得·洛德韦克·克拉默。该流派融合了青年风格、工艺美术运动、比利时新艺术、17 世纪荷兰建筑和印度尼西亚艺术等元素。

items.title_en: Multi-Token Prediction Done Right
items.title_zh: 正确实现多 Token 预测
items.summary_en: The paper identifies a problem in standard multi-token prediction training: a noisy residual in the gradient increasingly interferes with next-token and multi-token learning as models scale. It decomposes the gradient into a useful KL self-distillation term and a low-signal residual. The authors introduce KL gradient recovery and use it in Soft Multi-Token Prediction, which requires no vocabulary-sized logit matrices and can work with standard fused cross-entropy kernels. The method is presented as a one-line code change to MTP.
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文指出，标准多 Token 预测训练中的一个梯度噪声问题，会随着模型规模扩大而越来越干扰下一个 Token 和多 Token 学习。研究人员将该梯度分解为有用的 KL 自蒸馏项和低信号残差项。论文提出了 KL 梯度恢复方法，并将其用于 Soft Multi-Token Prediction；该方法无需构造与词表等大的 logit 矩阵，也能兼容标准融合交叉熵内核。作者称，Soft-MTP 只需对 MTP 做一行代码修改。

items.title_en: The Unwilding of Patagonia's Pollinators
items.title_zh: 巴塔哥尼亚传粉者的“去野化”
items.summary_en: In Patagonia, native bumblebees are being replaced by industrial honeybees. The change is affecting the region's ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 在巴塔哥尼亚，原生熊蜂正被工业化饲养的蜜蜂取代。这一变化正在影响当地生态系统。

items.title_en: Sailing Solo Around Britain
items.title_zh: 独自环航英国
items.summary_en: The sailor prepared the more-than-40-year-old fiberglass Leisure 27 Dark Star for a solo voyage around Britain. After owning the boat for more than 29 years, they replaced its engine, saildrive, fuel tank, rudder, mast, rigging, and sails. They considered the boat fundamentally well prepared for the journey.
items.summary_zh: 船主准备驾驶一艘船龄超过 40 年的玻璃钢 Leisure 27 双龙骨帆船 Dark Star，独自环航英国。船主拥有这艘船 29 年以上，近年来更换了发动机、帆船传动装置、油箱、舵、桅杆、索具和帆。船主认为，Dark Star 的基本状况已经足以应对这次航行。

items.title_en: Here Be Monsters
items.title_zh: 这里有怪物
items.summary_en: The author examines why monsters appeared so frequently in politics, entertainment, and everyday life during 2025. This led to research into monster studies and a conversation with Michael Chemers, director of the Center for Monster Studies at UC Santa Cruz. Chemers described monster theory as a way to examine contemporary problems, including environmental collapse.
items.summary_zh: 作者探讨了为什么“怪物”在 2025 年频繁出现在政治、娱乐和日常生活中。由此，作者开始研究怪物研究领域，并采访了加州大学圣克鲁兹分校怪物研究中心主任迈克尔·切默斯。切默斯认为，怪物理论可以用来审视包括环境崩溃在内的当代问题。
